payload.comment: Prior-art stage evidence is internally consistent and well-grounded. All seven ideas are appropriately scoped as hypotheses to validate, each citing a source whose text snippet supports the quoted evidence. All six sources carry complete metadata (origin, timestamp, snapshot path, SHA-256, title, URL) and were retrieved at 2026-10-01T17:51:31, before the current UTC stamp. No retrieval errors. Cross-references are clean: every source_id cited in ideas and proposals resolves to an entry in the sources array. The two proposals are consistent with the cited literature and with the 28×28×3 MedMNIST distribution. The compact_conv_token_transformer architecture is mathematically coherent: 28→14→7 spatial reduction via two stride-2 convs yields 7×7×128 = 49 tokens of dim 128; 4 attention heads × head_dim 32 = 128, matching the token dimension; the classification head targets 9 PathMNIST classes; the parameter budget (<2 M) is plausible for the described depth. The hflip_only_aug proposal is conservative, well-justified by the label-preservation rationale, and correctly excludes rotations that could invert tissue polarity. test_metrics_used is false, appropriate for this stage. No deterministic findings are present. No issues warrant revision or stop.
